events.title: October 23 Update Notes
events.summary: October 23 Update NotesSorry this update is a few days late. I was unwell for a while. This update includes gameplay changes and may have some bugs. If anything goes wrong, I'll fix it and release an update as soon as possible.\ Reworked into a three-day turn-based loot run. At night, trade what you bring back at camp for War Funds, Research and Reward Points.\ War Funds and the star chart have been replaced by Blessings. Pick twice per tower-defense battle, one card out of three, with rerolls.

events.title: October 16 Update Notes
events.summary: October 16 Update NotesThis update covers changes made from 5 PM on October 13 (UTC+8) through this update.This update adds late-game content. Multiplayer bugs are possible, and we will fix them as soon as we find them.1. \ Reworked into three real-time tower-defense battles where losing your home base ends the run, with a hidden ending to discover.2. \ Each wave now sets out on its timer, enemy health bars show status effects, and the hidden ending's reversal now plays out on the battlefield.3.

October 13 Update NotesThis update covers changes made from 8 PM on October 12 (UTC+8) through this update.1. \ Three-choice rewards can now be rerolled. You get 1 reroll on entering each world and 1 more for every 2 rewards you skip, up to 5. Rerolls carry over between worlds and work on personal rewards from battles, chests and events.2. \ The exchange has a new Special category. Fixed issues with certain exchanges, inventory drag-and-drop, and ability effects; optimized combat interface performance. Added a collapse/expand function to the dense target list and corrected issues with list overlapping and corpse selection. Standardized the success rate for attribute checks to a range of 5%–95%.
Update notes: Addresses issues that had previously regressed due to UI changes.

This is a minor fix and update:Fixed an issue where all category names on the Main God Space exchange page were displayed as "All."Adjusted the layout of categories and sorting options on the exchange page to improve the clarity of the Chinese and English text.Fixed an issue where chat bullet comments were not displaying correctly.

events.title: playtest has concluded, and the free demo is now availab
events.summary: The Reincarnation Squad playtest has concluded, and the free demo is now available.Thank you to everyone who participated in the playtest and provided feedback. *Reincarnation Squad* has now entered the demo phase; please visit the store page to download the free trial version. Future public demo updates will be released through this version. You are also welcome to add the full game to your wishlist to stay updated on its development.
